edits.description: Retained the complete RgnOp module and applicable original comments. Omitted the later EASE header.
Replaced the GrafTypes include with its required equates and their dependencies. Retained procedure parameters and local EQU declarations.
Made PC operands, branch sizes and applicable ADDQ or SUBQ encodings explicit. Matched source branches to ROM branches in order; every branch condition agrees.
Retained every UNLINK invocation and supplied the restored 68000 macro used by the reconstructed Regions module.
Set SetHSize to $408798, the destination of the ROM JSR instructions.

Replaced the three C970 instructions that zero-extend MAXBYTES with ADD MAXBYTES(A6),A0. The ROM uses signed word addition; the November 22, 1987 history entry records the later change to unsigned addition.

Retained the _StackAvail invocation and restored its inline MOVE.L SP,D0 and SUB.L HeapEnd,D0 instructions. HeapEnd is $0114, as defined in Interfaces/AIncludes/SysEqu.a. The GrafTypes history records the later switch to the stack-space routine on June 6, 1989.
Preserved the original file heading, copyright notice and routine comments. Removed the C970 history entry and the three comments attached to its removed instructions.

verification.result: All 722 assembled instruction bytes equal the ROM span. All 7 recorded entry points match their addresses.
verification.method: Used the shared translator on the preserved source, assembled for the 68000, linked at the ROM address, checked for unresolved relocations and compared every byte with the ROM.
removed_comment_texts: get long version of MaxBytes   <C970/22Nov87> DAF
limitations: MPW assembly has not been run.
Byte equality does not establish the original macro spelling, source formatting or label spelling.
